items.title: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items.detailText:
Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock. Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders. Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders. Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares of its Class A common stock.
The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share. Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
The proposed offering will be made only by means of a prospectus. Copies of the preliminary prospectus may be obtained from: Goldman Sachs & Co. items.title: Introducing Muse Spark 1.1
items.detailText:
Today, we’re excited to introduce Muse Spark 1.1, the latest model from Meta Superintelligence Labs and a significant upgrade from Muse Spark. Muse Spark 1.1 is a multimodal reasoning model built for agentic tasks, with major gains in tool and computer use, coding, and multimodal understanding.
With these improvements, Muse Spark 1.1 advances the performance-efficiency frontier. Together with this week’s launch of Muse Image , this release brings us closer to our vision of personal superintelligence: models that help you pursue your goals, create what you imagine, deepen your relationships, and take action on what you value most.
Along with this release, we are launching a public preview of the new Meta Model API where developers can access Muse Spark 1.1. The model is available now in "Thinking" mode in the Meta AI app and on meta.ai .
For more details about our evaluations, see our report .
Muse Spark 1.1 delivers exceptional performance in personal agentic tasks that require planning and orchestration across a range of external apps and services. It zero-shot generalizes to new native tools, MCP servers, and custom skills.
It tackles complex projects significantly faster than Muse Spark, as it is trained to orchestrate multi-agent systems to optimize end-to-end latency. As the main agent, it can gather context, make a plan, and delegate execution across parallel subagents. As a subagent, it adheres to its job, understands available tools, and knows when to escalate back to the main agent.
Muse Spark 1.1 can actively manage its context window of 1 million tokens. It remembers actions, retrieves information from much earlier work, and compacts in a way that keeps the critical steps needed for later work.
Muse Spark 1.1 excels at computer-use workflows that unfold across multiple applications with information changing on-the-fly. It maintains context across extended sessions, adapts to evolving requirements, and navigates unfamiliar interfaces with minimal human intervention.
Rather than reasoning through every desktop step one click at a time, Muse Spark 1.1 understands when to automate and when to use the interface directly. We trained the model to write scripts when automation is faster, click when direct interaction is simpler, and generate batches of actions at each step.

items.title: Introducing Muse Image and Muse Video
items.detailText:
Muse Image follows instructions faithfully, edits with precision, composes from multiple references, and draws on Instagram for social context. Muse...
We’re excited to launch Muse Image and preview Muse Video, the first media generation models developed by Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Image is our most advanced image generation model yet: it follows instructions faithfully, edits with precision, and composes from multiple references. It also brings agentic tool use capabilities and integrates with Muse Spark. Muse Video, built on the same pretraining base, delivers exceptional visual fidelity with native audio support.
Muse Image is available today across the Meta AI app and on meta.ai , Instagram Stories in the US, and WhatsApp in limited countries, and is coming soon to Facebook. Muse Video is coming soon to creators and Meta AI.
Instead of directly mapping prompts to images, Muse Image operates as an agent: it invokes search and coding tools to improve accuracy, self-refines its own generations, and improves through scaling test-time compute. Muse Image also integrates with Muse Spark, allowing the two models to share tools and plan jointly for powerful agentic media generation.
We provide Muse Image with access to tools to enhance its agentic capabilities.
Coding. During reinforcement learning, Muse Image learns to write and execute code that produces accurate plots and QR codes, and condition on rendered figures to improve the accuracy of generated images. Muse Spark and Muse Image also integrate to use the combination of code and media generation to create animated GIFs, websites with embedded images, and interactive visual games.
Search. Muse Image learns to search the web to ground generated images in factual and real-time information and visual references. Enabling search improves factual accuracy on knowledge-intensive prompts, particularly those involving current events and real-world facts.
Muse Image improves with search tool use. Win rate from internal ablation.
Muse Image reflects on and improves upon its own work within its chain of thought. This self-refining behavior can take different forms: a local edit to the current image draft when a small detail is off, a new image generation from scratch when larger parts are wrong, or a different tactic like tool use for more factually accurate generation. We didn’t design this behavior. Instead, it emerged during RL training simply because self-refinement produced better images and therefore higher reward.

This article introduces the updated Alibaba Cloud DevOps AI Assistant, which provides automated, context-aware support across the entire software development lifecycle.
Before we begin: If you already use Alibaba Cloud DevOps to manage requirements, code, and pipelines, this update is worth a few minutes of your time to get reacquainted with your "new colleague." It requires no separate login or switching between tools. Instead, it is embedded directly in the pages you open every day, covering key stages of development collaboration, from requirement entry, test case generation, and code review to pipeline troubleshooting and release decisions.
Alibaba Cloud DevOps AI Assistant requires no separate login; its capabilities are built into the various pages of Alibaba Cloud DevOps. It runs through the core development collaboration workflow:
In a nutshell: tell it what you want to achieve in natural language, and it gets the work done in the pages you already know.
Alibaba Cloud DevOps AI Assistant currently has three entry points, serving three types of needs: asking questions directly, using features with one click in context, and running tasks automatically in the background.
An "AI Assistant" icon appears at the top of Alibaba Cloud DevOps pages. Click it to open the chat dialog. Whatever page you are on, you can ask questions directly in natural language and have it help you complete your work.
In addition to the entry point at the top of the page, Alibaba Cloud DevOps embeds AI buttons directly in many feature-specific scenarios, such as improving requirement content on the requirement details page, troubleshooting errors on the pipeline page, and fixing issues with one click on the code scan results page. Clicking a button automatically supplies the current context and prompt, so you do not have to formulate your request from scratch.
Under "AI Assistant Tasks" in your Alibaba Cloud DevOps personal workbench, you can turn frequently repeated work into automated tasks. items.title: Claude 上线白板和表格，把打工人当甲方伺候
items.detailText:
微软又挨了重重一击。
11月10日，Anthropic一口气推出了三款新工具：Claude Whiteboards、Claude Sheets和Claude Data，分别对应白板、电子表格和数据分析。
其中最有意思的当属白板。用户可以直接在上面圈圈画画，告诉Claude哪里需要调整、哪里需要补充，Claude就能根据这些操作理解需求，继续完成工作。
另外两款工具则让Claude能够直接制作和编辑电子表格，分析数据、生成可视化报告。
以前得费劲琢磨怎么写提示词的事，现在直接画给它看就行了。Excel、Word和PowerPoint这些传统办公软件，似乎也迎来了新的竞争对手。
“那些年一直拒绝学习Excel、Word和PowerPoint的努力，现在终于有了回报。”
距离交付只剩12天，他们需要确定口味、计算成本、安排运输，还得保证产品按时送到消费者手中。
Claude直接在白板上绘制出了一条项目时间线，将各项任务按照日期排列，配上图标、插画和负责人信息。团队成员则可以在白板上自由添加内容、调整任务顺序，与Claude一起修改计划。
这就是新推出的Claude Whiteboards（白板）——就像打工人会议室里常见的那块。
你可以通过文字、语音或者随手绘制的图形向Claude表达想法。即使计划还很混乱，Claude也能尝试将其整理成流程图、时间线或者不同的任务模块。
整个过程支持多人实时协作。团队成员可以像使用普通在线白板一样，直接拖动和修改内容。等讨论结束，Claude还能将白板整理成文档、演示文稿，或者发送到Miro、Lucid等专业工具中继续编辑。
如果说，白板负责把想法整理清楚，那么Claude Sheets（表格）就负责把数字和任务安排明白。
你只需要提出需求，例如制作一份招聘预算表，Claude就能自动创建电子表格，添加多个工作表、公式、下拉菜单以及相应的格式。表格生成后，你和Claude可以继续在同一份文件中工作。想增加一列预算余额，或者突出显示已经逾期的任务，直接告诉Claude即可。
Claude会在对应单元格中完成修改，并标记改动的位置，方便用户检查。表格也可以导出为Excel或CSV文件。
它实际上是此前Claude Dashboards的升级版本，能够连接企业使用的数据库和业务软件，例如Snowflake、Google BigQuery和Salesforce。
你可以直接询问某个季度的销售表现，Claude会根据数据生成图表、可交互的仪表盘，以及附有文字解读的数据报告。
还升级了交互式连接器（Interactive Connectors）。Adobe、Atlassian、Notion等合作伙伴的工具可以直接在Claude中打开，用户能够一边操作原有软件，一边让Claude协助修改内容。
目前Claude Whiteboards和Sheets仍处于测试阶段，Claude Data已正式开放，但部分高级功能仍在测试中。三款工具均面向Claude付费计划提供，其中Sheets暂时只能满足相对基础的电子表格需求。
Claude越来越像一个真实的打工人，现在不仅要负责制作表格、整理数据，连开会时满白板的“指手画脚”，也得看懂并执行了。
在Hacker News的讨论中，一名用户回忆，自己此前需要用Excel为创业公司制作人员规模预测模型，结果直接让Claude开发了一个应用，功能更丰富，花费的时间还少得多。
另一位用户也分享了此前的体验，称自己第一次用Claude制作演示文稿后，就再也不想主动打开PowerPoint了。
此前，这些工作还需要用户利用Claude已有的能力自行完成。如今，Anthropic进一步推出了官方白板、表格和数据分析工具，让更多用户可以直接上手。
11月10日，Anthropic宣布进军办公软件后，微软股价盘中一度下跌超过3.5%，最终收跌约2.2%。
外媒直接以Anthropic推出办公软件、微软股价大跌为题报道了这一事件。Claude Sheets与微软Excel、谷歌Sheets的功能有所重叠，也让市场重新担忧传统办公软件可能受到AI冲击。
网友们甚至替Anthropic编排了一出商业喜剧：先说服微软成为IPO的重要投资者，再转头去颠覆它的业务。
被冲击的显然不只有微软，评论区里还有网友调侃：“醒醒吧，宝贝，Claude刚刚又干掉了一家AI初创公司。”
随着Claude不断推出新功能，原本依靠某一项AI能力创业的公司，也可能突然发现自己的产品被Claude直接做了出来。
有网友表示，自己一直在等Claude让微软Office和谷歌Workspace变得无关紧要，随后又补上一句：“等你们开始处理电子邮件和日历的时候，也记得告诉我。”
网友们似乎已经自觉进入了甲方的角色，而这一次，Anthropic连开需求会的白板都准备好了。
每逢Claude发布新模型、新功能，评论区总少不了一批抱怨账号被封的国内用户。毕竟中国大陆一直没有进入Claude的官方支持地区名单。
10月8日，Anthropic发布年度使用政策更新公告，进一步明确了《支持地区政策》（Supported Regions Policy）的适用规则，新版政策将于11月12日正式生效。
简单来说， Anthropic现在不仅要看你人在哪儿，还要看你替谁工作，甚至要查你公司的老板是谁。
你人在中国大陆，即便替一家美国公司工作，也不能使用Claude；反过来，你人在美国，但公司注册在中国大陆，或者总部设在中国大陆，同样不行。
就算公司注册在新加坡，只要背后的多数股权掌握在不支持地区的个人或企业手里，也不符合使用资格。想通过海外公司调用API，或者借助第三方云平台使用Claude，也绕不开这些限制。
这些规定几乎覆盖了Anthropic旗下的全部产品和服务，从Claude.ai、Claude Code到API，甚至包括通过第三方云平台提供的Claude模型。
当然，限制并非首次出现。Anthropic表示，早在2025年就已经开始限制不支持地区实体多数持股的企业使用Claude，此次更新主要是进一步明确规则。
11月10日，Anthropic宣布启动IPO路演，计划在纳斯达克以“ANT”为股票代码上市，拟发行8.25亿股，预计发行价区间为每股70至78美元。

items.title: 奇袭Claude，谷歌Gemini新旗舰全面上线，一夜复刻OpenCode桌面应用
items.detailText:
API限时半价。
智东西11月11日消息，今天凌晨，谷歌宣布其 最强AI模型Gemini 4 Carbon 正式向开发者、企业、科研人员和消费者开放。Gemini 4 Carbon在 网络安全能力 和复杂知识工作、软件工程和科学推理等领域的 长程Agent工作流 中，均达到前沿水平。
两周前（10月28日），Gemini 4 Carbon发布，并通过Fairwind计划向一批网络安全工作人员开放。此次扩大开放后，开发者和企业用户可通过Google AI Studio和Gemini for business调用API。Google AI Ultra订阅用户可在Google Antigravity、Gemini应用和谷歌搜索AI模式中体验该模型。
在用于衡量模型实际工作流表现的独立基准测试中，Carbon兼顾了前沿的准确性和实际部署的成本。它在Cursor测评榜单CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity的WANDR和Zapier的AutomationBench中均 排名第一 ，单任务成本不到排名最高的外部模型的一半， 优于Fable 5.2、Opus 5.5 等模型。
Gemini 4 Carbon在CursorBench 4.0测评中表现（图源：Cursor）
在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index上，Gemini 4 Carbon（high）以60分 排名第二 ，仅 落后于Claude Fable 5.2（max） ，超越Claude opus 5.5（max）、GPT-6 Astra（max）和GPT-6.1 Sol（max）等一众模型。
Gemini 4 Carbon在Artificial Analysis榜单上位列第二（图源：Artificial Analysis）
价格方面，Gemini 4 Carbon的API尝鲜价与Argon相同，每百万输入Token为 2美元（约合人民币13.3元） ，每百万输出Token为 10美元（约合人民币66.7元） ，优惠持续至 11月30日 。此后的输入和输出价格分别为4美元（约合人民币26.7元）和20美元（约合人民币133.4元）。
目前，在Gemini 4系列中，谷歌仍推荐用Argon处理大多数软件工程和知识工作。Carbon则面向 复杂代码调试、开放式科学研究 等更难的任务，会 消耗更多Token ，进行更深入的推理，反复验证结果。
谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊（Sundar Pichai）发文称：“Carbon做了个鹈鹕骑车的Demo，所以你不用专门测试。”动画中，鹈鹕在谷歌园区中骑行。飞跃斜坡后，鹈鹕会张开翅膀维持平衡，随后平稳降落在地面上继续骑行。
模型开放后，部分开发者在海外社交平台X上发文称，Gemini 4 Carbon较Argon提升明显，能力很强，思考方式与Claude、GPT有所不同。
还有开发者称，Gemini 4 Carbon较Gemini以往模型进步较大，但审美不如Fable和Opus，需要更详细的提示词或参考案例来引导。
在法律、金融和企业运营等场景中，Carbon可以检索和分析大量文档，结合其中的图表、图片和表格得出有材料支撑的结论，再按指定结构和格式生成电子表格、演示文稿或报告。
为了考察Agent处理工程蓝图、示意图和数据表等复杂资料的能力，谷歌与Artificial Analysis合作推出了多模态知识Agent评测（Multimodal Knowledge Agent，MKA）。谷歌称，Carbon在这项测试中排名第二，平均单任务成本不到榜首模型的六分之一。
谷歌展示了Carbon如何把不同类型的资料做成交互应用。其中，一组Carbon Agent根据一条提示词，将历史照片和工程图版做成了基于Three.js的3D展览，呈现埃菲尔铁塔从1887年到1889年的建造过程。
在另一项演示中，Carbon团队根据一条提示词和7份市议会公开的规划PDF，从中提取206张工程视图，经过一夜10轮迭代，做出了谷歌Platform 37办公楼的交互式3D模型，包含约90.6万个三角面。
谷歌称，Carbon擅长需要多Agent协作的工程任务，包括跨软件包迁移、跨子系统排查故障根因和复杂架构重构。在开发网页应用时，Carbon会反复构建、运行和验证，遇到错误后尝试恢复，并检查源代码和页面实际渲染效果。
OpenCode团队曾在下班前给Carbon一份需求清单，希望让桌面应用与现有界面框架保持视觉一致。第二天，Carbon已从零构建了一个Rust界面库，重写OpenCode桌面应用，并交付了可运行的演示。HubX则在包含1.4万项测试的代码库中，用16项真实Bug修复任务测试Carbon，结果修复率为94%，测试中未出现回归。
谷歌展示的案例中，Carbon以Gemini Omni生成的视频为参考，在Blender中构建程序化遗迹、水下焦散光照和水体仿真，再将水下亚特兰蒂斯场景移植到Three.js，在浏览器中实时渲染，生成可交互3D游戏。
Gemini 4 Carbon具备谷歌迄今最强的网络安全能力，可以为安全团队保护关键软件提供端到端支持。通过Fairwind计划使用的Carbon，在漏洞发现（S EC -bench Pro）、漏洞利用（ExploitGym）和漏洞修复（CWE-bench v1）三项关键评测中领先。
谷歌在内部自动化安全项目Project Fortify中测试了Carbon。该项目覆盖扫描、分诊和修复。按谷歌内部评测，Carbon的扫描召回率达到100%，分诊精确率达到95%。在开源代码库测试中，其漏洞发现召回率较Argon相对提升超过25%，识别出此前遗漏的逻辑漏洞。
在谷歌旗下网络安全公司Wiz的“Scan for Good”项目中，团队用Carbon评估公共数字基础设施的安全性。谷歌称，Wiz在检查两家大型SaaS服务商时，不到两小时就发现了此前未知的漏洞，随后与受影响机构合作修复，潜在影响涉及数万家公司。
谷歌称，Carbon在物理、数学和生命科学推理方面有所提升，可用于整合实验数据、检验假设和处理多步骤问题。药物毒性研究公司Axiom Bio称，Carbon在其转化科学任务中表现最佳，帮助团队找到此前未发现的毒性机制。该公司正把用于实际科研的分析流程和Agent迁移到Carbon和Argon。

items.title: TI、Microchip、AMD都开始做SoM了
items.detailText:
TI、Microchip、AMD都开始做SoM了
11月5日，德州仪器（TI）宣布推出TICS100MOD多协议工业通信系统级模块（System-on-Module，SoM），支持EtherCAT、PROFINET和EtherNet/IP三种工业以太网协议，预计于2026年底供货。
SoM通常将处理器、存储器、电源管理以及必要的外围电路集成到一块小型PCB上，客户通过设计配套载板构建自己的嵌入式系统。
在嵌入式行业，Toradex、Variscite、PhyTec、创龙科技、米尔电子等专业模块厂商，长期围绕TI、NXP、ST及瑞萨等公司的处理器开发核心板，提供硬件设计、软件移植及技术支持。部分芯片厂商也拥有自主品牌的SoM产品，包括Microchip和AMD。
TI此次发布的TICS100MOD主要针对工业通信，将实时MCU、以太网PHY及工业协议支持集成到一块30mm×18mm的模块中。
TICS100MOD采用TI的AM2612实时MCU和DP83826AI以太网PHY，使用3.3V供电，支持SPI和QSPI主机接口，工作温度范围为-40℃至85℃。
工业自动化领域存在多种以太网通信协议。EtherCAT主要用于运动控制等对实时性要求较高的应用，PROFINET和EtherNet/IP也广泛应用于工业设备及自动化系统。
三种协议在通信机制、协议栈、实时性要求及生态上存在差异。设备厂商可以根据客户使用的工业控制系统，灵活提供相应的通信接口和协议支持。
模块采用的AM2612实时MCU集成双Arm Cortex-R5F内核，以及PRU-ICSS（可编程实时单元和工业通信子系统），通过专用实时处理资源执行工业以太网通信任务。
TICS100MOD还集成两个100Mbps以太网PHY，并提供工业协议栈、SDK和开发工具。
可通过SPI或QSPI接口将TICS100MOD连接到外部MCU或MPU，由模块负责工业以太网协议处理，外部主控继续执行设备控制、数据处理及应用程序。
TI已经推出了AM261-SOM-EVM开发板，用于实时控制MCU的评估和原型开发，TICS100MOD则围绕工业以太网通信配置硬件及协议软件，以独立模块产品的形式面向终端设备集成。
2017年，Microchip推出基于SAMA5D2微处理器的ATSAMA5D27-SOM1，将Arm Cortex-A5处理器、DDR存储器、Flash、以太网PHY和电源管理等功能集成到一块小型PCB上。
随后，Microchip推出SAM9X60D1G-SOM等产品。该模块采用600MHz Arm926EJ-S处理器，集成1Gbit DDR2存储器，面向工业控制、人机界面和嵌入式Linux系统。
Microchip还围绕SAMA7D65等新一代MPU扩展SoM产品线，提供处理器、存储器、电源管理及网络接口的集成方案。
Microchip的部分SoM采用适合表面贴装的结构，客户可以通过标准贴装及回流焊工艺，将模块直接焊接到自己的主板上。Microchip还提供配套数据手册、Linux支持及生产装配指南。
其中，Kria K26基于Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC，整合Arm处理器、FPGA可编程逻辑、DDR4存储器和eMMC等资源，主要面向机器视觉、机器人及边缘AI应用。
Kria K24则主要面向工业电机控制和数字信号处理应用，提供处理器、可编程逻辑、存储器及相关外围电路。
在无线连接领域，乐鑫科技长期同时提供ESP32系列芯片和无线模组。例如，ESP32-S3-WROOM-1将ESP32-S3 MCU、Flash、射频匹配电路及天线等集成在一起，客户可以将模块直接用于物联网终端。
Silicon Labs也提供MGM240S等无线模块，将无线SoC、射频外围电路和天线集成到标准化模块中，并提供相应的认证支持。
广州创龙科技主要从事Arm、DSP及多核异构处理器核心板、评估板和嵌入式系统开发，覆盖TI、NXP、AMD及包括瑞芯微、全志等多家国产处理器厂商的产品。
在TI平台上，创龙科技提供基于AM335x、AM437x、AM57x、AM62x、AM62Lx和AM64x等处理器的核心板，以及部分DSP和C2000相关产品。
核心板采用邮票孔、板对板连接器等不同连接方式，应用于工业自动化、能源电力、仪器仪表及通信设备。创龙科技还提供配套底板、软件开发包和应用开发支持。
米尔电子围绕TI、NXP、ST、瑞萨等处理器平台开发了多种核心板，同时覆盖瑞芯微、全志、芯驰等国内芯片平台。
例如，米尔电子基于TI AM62x开发了MYC-YM62X核心板，集成Arm Cortex-A53处理器、存储器及外围电路，主要面向工业控制、物联网和人机界面等应用。
飞凌嵌入式同样提供多种Arm处理器核心板，覆盖NXP、TI、瑞萨及国产处理器平台，并提供Linux、Android等软件支持。
广州致远电子（ZLG）围绕工业嵌入式应用提供核心板、工控板及配套开发工具，涉及工业通信、数据采集和边缘计算等领域。
正点原子也推出了基于STM32、NXP及TI等处理器的核心板和开发套件，提供相应的开发资料及软件支持。
2026年4月14日，TI表示，正在与创龙科技、米尔电子、正点原子三家中国企业围绕AM62L处理器开展的SoM合作。
AM62L是TI面向成本敏感型嵌入式应用推出的处理器系列，采用Arm Cortex-A53架构，主要面向工业控制、人机界面及嵌入式Linux设备。
在这次合作中，创龙科技围绕AM62L开发了采用LGA和LCC等结构的工业核心板，提供不同的安装方式及配套开发平台。米尔电子和正点原子也分别围绕AM62L处理器推出核心板与开发套件，提供相应的软件开发资料及硬件设计支持。
Toradex围绕TI AM62x推出Verdin AM62等模块产品，提供Linux软件支持以及不同配置的配套载板。
Variscite围绕TI AM62x、AM62P以及此前的AM335x、AM437x等处理器开发核心板，提供不同的内存、接口及产品配置。
Ezurio也基于TI AM62x、AM62L及AM67x等处理器推出Carbon系列SoM，配套提供Linux开发环境及硬件开发支持。
PHYT EC 则长期围绕TI Sitara系列处理器提供工业级核心板、开发套件及定制嵌入式设计服务。
TI此次推出的TICS100MOD聚焦工业以太网通信，支持EtherCAT、PROFINET和EtherNet/IP三种协议，客户通过SPI或QSPI接口将其连接到自己的主控处理器。
本文来自微信公众号 “电子工程世界”（ID：EEworldbbs） ，作者：冀凯，36氪经授权发布。

items.detailText:
This article introduces AgentScope 2.0, an Agent Harness that orchestrates complex, long-horizon enterprise AI tasks.
AgentScope 2.0 is both a deeply customizable Agent Framework and, more importantly, a general-purpose Agent Harness for enterprise tasks.
Enterprise requirements for Agents are expanding beyond connecting models and tools to handling complex tasks on an ongoing basis and providing services to multiple business teams. Four common starting points for building Agents have emerged around these requirements:
These four starting points reflect different divisions of responsibility and can also be combined. When choosing among them, enterprises need to consider the depth of customization, data and execution boundaries, and operational capabilities. items.title: AI Guardrails Checklist: 7 Controls Every Enterprise Deployment Needs on Day One
items.description: AI Guardrails Checklist: 7 Controls Every Enterprise Deployment Needs on Day One Guardrails are not distrust. They are what make a production launch signable. In this guide, we will discuss seven runtime guardrails, placed in the order a re
items.detailText:
Guardrails are not distrust. They are what make a production launch signable. In this guide, we will discuss seven runtime guardrails, placed in the order a request meets them.
Only 5% of companies have the full set of controls in place for agentic AI (BCG, Applied AI Index 2026, 2026). Many still launch with one guardrail: the model's own judgment. A model-based check on every request can cost under 3% of the model bill. Skipping it is the expensive choice.
Guardrails are not distrust. They are what make a production launch signable.
Agent adoption is moving faster than the controls around it.
In a survey of 3,235 respondents across 24 countries, 74% expect at least moderate agent use by 2027, while only 21% report mature governance for agentic AI (Deloitte, State of AI in the Enterprise, 2026). The gap shows up at launch: a well-written system prompt and the hope that the model behaves.
Risk leads and platform engineers face two bad options. Block launch until a full governance program exists, and the business routes around you with unmanaged tools. Wave it through with a policy document, and the first incident becomes your governance program.
The answer is a short, fixed set of runtime guardrails that ship with the first production request, each with an owner and a metric. Seven is enough. This is not about data residency or sector regulation; it is about what runs in the request path, every time.
If a launch date is already on the calendar, check your request path for missing guardrails with the team.
Governance on paper does not run in the request path. Guardrails do.
Read these as a pipeline, not a list of policies: each sits at a specific point between the user and the response.
1. Input filtering. Screen the prompt before the model sees it: jailbreak attempts, prompt injection carried in documents or web pages, and requests far outside the application's purpose. A topic allowlist ("this assistant answers billing questions") catches more real misuse than a long blocklist.
2. Output moderation. Check what the model produces before the user or a downstream system sees it. For streamed responses, check as tokens arrive rather than after the full answer, or the user reads the problem before you catch it.
3. PII handling. Detect and mask personal data on the way in, and check for it on the way out. Redact before the model, before tools, and before logs: the log is the copy most teams forget.
4. Tool permissioning. Give an agent the least privilege its task needs. Separate read tools from write tools, allowlist the systems it can call, and require approval for any action that moves money, sends external messages or deletes records.

items.title: Expanding our partnership with GSA to bring Claude to all levels of government
items.detailText:
Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API. For the first time, the discount applies across every product surface, including when agencies buy from us directly today and through cloud providers in the coming months. The discount also extends to state, local, tribal and territorial governments.
We are also launching a dedicated program to help agencies implement and make the most of their Claude use. These programs are commonly leveraged by our private sector customers and we’re looking forward to bringing those best practices to our public sector partners in the coming weeks.
The discounts offered through the agreement are estimated to save the government $1 billion. Agencies are not bound by a minimum spend commitment and will be able to pay for the usage they consume.
Government agencies are using Claude to solve some of their most important challenges. Examples include managing backlogs, records and forms, and modernizing old code. Some of the ways agencies are using Claude include:
Agencies can use Claude for their most sensitive unclassified work. Claude for Government, which delivers Claude's coding and agentic work capabilities and provides near-feature parity with commercial offerings at a FedRAMP High authorization level, was made generally available on September 30.
Agencies building their own tools can use Claude through Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud’s Vertex AI. On Bedrock, Claude is authorized for FedRAMP High, with select models authorized for DoD IL4 and IL5 workloads in AWS GovCloud. On Vertex AI, Claude is authorized for FedRAMP High.
Claude Enterprise is in process for FedRAMP Moderate authorization through the FedRAMP 20x program, marking the next evolution of how we are bringing the same innovative technology available commercially to the government.
Government agencies can buy Claude at the OneGov discount through GSA's Multiple Award Schedule today. Whether your department or agency already uses Claude or is interested in using it, our Public Sector team will help discuss your options.
Anthropic is a Public Benefit Corporation. Our mission is the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for the long-term benefit of humanity.
